sections.title: Clock Town
sections.note: It comes back every cycle: bring it once as a Deku for magic and again as human Link for the Great Fairy's Mask.

items.name: Clock Town Stray Fairy
items.howTo: By day it floats in the Laundry Pool (hop across to it); at night it floats high in the middle of East Clock Town, reached by flying into it from the nearby Deku Flower. Carry it to the Great Fairy Fountain in North Clock Town.
items.notes: Respawns every cycle. Return it as Deku Link (first cycle) for Magic Power, and again in a later cycle as human Link for the Great Fairy's Mask. As human, the daytime Laundry Pool spot is the easy one (the night spot needs the Deku Flower). Same locations in 3DS.

sections.title: Woodfall Temple
sections.note: Stray Fairies go back to their spots with the Song of Time, so collect all 15 and take them to the fountain in one cycle. The Great Fairy's Mask draws free fairies to you.

items.name: Entrance hall: floating ahead of the door
items.howTo: Floating straight ahead as you enter. Fly into it from the Deku Flower on the first platform, or wear the Great Fairy's Mask to pull it in.

items.name: Entrance hall: chest on the second platform
items.howTo: Fly as Deku from the first platform's Deku Flower east (right) to the second platform and open the large chest.

items.name: Main room: Deku Baba at the foot of the ramp
items.howTo: Go down the wooden ramp from the entrance door and kill the regular Deku Baba at the bottom; it leaves the fairy.

items.name: Main room: pots on the south-east island
items.howTo: Hop the lily pads as Deku to the east door, then hop right onto the small platform in the south-east corner and break the pots; one holds the fairy.

items.name: East room: beehive by the Small Key chest
items.area: East room (Small Key chamber, elevating Deku Flower)
items.howTo: From the platform with the Small Key chest, look left (north-west corner): shoot the beehive on the wall with a Deku bubble, then grab the fairy with the Great Fairy's Mask or by dropping into the poison water as Deku.
items.notes: 3DS: this beehive is instead on the upper level of the room, right beside the 2F door (collected later).

items.name: West room: Skulltula on the right-hand path
items.howTo: After pushing the Majora-marked block forward, take the right path around and kill the Skulltula; it drops the fairy.

items.name: Dark room: chest after the Black Boes
items.howTo: Kill all the Black Boes (spin through them as Deku) and open the large chest that appears to the south.

items.name: Main room 2F: bubble on the north side
items.howTo: After the Dinolfos/Bow, on the north side of the upper platform a fairy floats in a bubble; touch or slash it to release it.
items.notes: Reachable once you come back down to the main room's top floor; walkthroughs grab it right after getting the Bow.

items.name: Main room: chest from the north-west floor switch
items.howTo: From the 2F Deku Flower fly west to the small platform with the unlit torch in the north-west corner, take off the mask and step on the floor switch. A chest appears near the main room's entrance door; go open it.

items.name: West room: beehive under the upper platform
items.howTo: Stand by the pushed block and look up: a beehive hangs under the platform above it. Shoot it down with the Bow and collect the fairy (Great Fairy's Mask helps).
items.notes: 3DS: the beehive here is shot with a Deku bubble earlier on (it's the one nearer the south end).

items.name: West room: bubble under the bridge
items.howTo: From the north side of the room (by the torch and Compass-room door) turn round and look under the bridge below the block: shoot the bubble with an arrow and pull it in with the Great Fairy's Mask, or, once the water is purified, swim into it.
items.notes: N64 only. In 3DS this fairy does not exist; instead one floats in the lower north-east corner of the 2F flying-platform (Dragonfly) room.

items.name: Pre-boss room: lower east alcove
items.howTo: Climb down the ladder and use the Deku Flowers to reach the east (right) alcoves; the fairy floats in a bubble in the lower one.

items.name: Pre-boss room: upper east alcove
items.howTo: Keep working up the east alcoves with the Deku Flowers; the next bubble is in the alcove above the previous one.

items.name: Pre-boss room: west alcove
items.howTo: Fly over to the west (left) side and work up its alcoves to the fairy bubble.

items.name: Pre-boss room: inside the flame pillar
items.howTo: The last fairy is trapped in the flames in the middle. Shoot it with an arrow and pull it in with the Great Fairy's Mask, or hit the crystal switch to drop the flames briefly and fly into it as Deku.

sections.title: Snowhead Temple
sections.note: Stray Fairies go back to their spots with the Song of Time, so collect all 15 and take them to the fountain in one cycle. The Great Fairy's Mask draws free fairies to you.

items.name: Bridge room: bubble inside the pillar
items.howTo: In the room with the Freezards and the roll-across bridge, a fairy is in a bubble inside the pillar holding up the second half of the bridge (easier to see from below). Shoot it and reel it in with the Great Fairy's Mask.
items.notes: StrategyWiki suggests the Lens of Truth to spot where to shoot; not needed per Zelda Dungeon.

items.name: Bridge room: bubble under the north ledge
items.howTo: Drop to the ground floor and walk over the lava as Goron to the north end; the bubble is under the ledge leading to the stairs. Shoot it and use the Great Fairy's Mask.
items.notes: 3DS: this fairy is at the east end of the room instead (shoot it, or walk round to it later).

items.name: Map room: floating in the north-west
items.howTo: Floating free near the north-west part of the room as you come up the stairs; just touch it.

items.name: Icicle room: hidden alcove chest
items.howTo: After clearing the stalactites with arrows, look for the patch of snow clinging to the wall on your right: a hidden alcove (Lens of Truth shows it). Jump in (Bunny Hood, or after breaking the nearby ice chunk) and open the chest.
items.notes: Lens of Truth optional (it just reveals the alcove).

items.name: Goron-switch room: invisible ceiling bubble
items.area: Switch puzzle room (2F, Goron pound switches)
items.howTo: Drop into the snowy area, Goron Pound the White Boes, then with the Lens of Truth look straight up: shoot the bubble in the middle of the ceiling and pull the fairy in with the Great Fairy's Mask.

items.name: Basement: Goron switch in the lava
items.howTo: Goron-roll off a ledge to the bottom of the main room. Stand on the large switch in a lava pool as Goron; a chest appears in another lava puddle.

items.name: Pillar room: chest after three Freezards
items.howTo: Melt the green doors with Fire Arrows, then kill all three Freezards in the pillar room (Fire Arrows or Goron punches); a chest appears.

items.name: Wolfos room: crate on a pillar
items.howTo: On the far side, a crate sits atop one of the pillars. Blow it up with a Bomb (thrown so it bursts in mid-air) and reel in the fairy with the Great Fairy's Mask.

items.name: Wolfos room: chest on the ledge
items.howTo: Melt the ice on the block and the floor switch with Fire Arrows, step on the switch to make a chest appear on a ledge, then push the block UP, RIGHT, DOWN (map view), climb it and open the chest.
items.notes: Afterwards push the block LEFT, UP, LEFT to reach the upper door to the double-block room.

items.name: Double-block room: chest beyond the snapped-in blocks
items.howTo: First visit: as Goron pull the stacked double block out for the Small Key, then push it all the way to the far west edge of the snow so it drops onto a switch and makes a chest appear. Later (from the Wolfos room's upper door) use the sunken blocks as a step to cross and open that chest.
items.notes: The block push must be done this cycle or the chest is unreachable; listed here in collection order (after the Wolfos room).

items.name: Map room: chest via invisible platforms
items.howTo: Melt the frozen eye switch with a Fire Arrow to raise the platform, go round the upper ledge, then use the Lens of Truth to cross the invisible floating blocks to an alcove in the south wall with a chest.

items.name: Eeno room: bubble in the hidden alcove
items.howTo: Kill the Eenos, then look at the snow hanging off an invisible ledge in the south of the room. Shoot the centre of the diamond-shaped hole to pop the bubble and pull the fairy in with the Great Fairy's Mask.
items.notes: Lens of Truth makes the alcove visible.

items.name: Dinolfos room: first Dinolfos
items.howTo: Kill the first of the two Dinolfos (a Goron Pound works well); it leaves a fairy.

items.name: Dinolfos room: second Dinolfos
items.howTo: Kill the second Dinolfos for the next fairy.

items.name: Main room: hidden north-west alcove chest
items.howTo: A hidden alcove (snow hanging off its ledge) in the north-west of the main room holds a chest. After punching out the central pillar's ice discs as Goron, stand at the north end of the top and drop/jump west onto the Deku Flower in the alcove (Bunny Hood jump, or a Goron roll off the edge).
items.notes: Lens of Truth helps line up the drop.

sections.title: Great Bay Temple
sections.note: Stray Fairies go back to their spots with the Song of Time, so collect all 15 and take them to the fountain in one cycle. The Great Fairy's Mask draws free fairies to you.

items.name: Entrance: light the four torches
items.howTo: Light the four unlit torches on the upper ledge in time (Deku Stick lit from the lower torches, or Fire Arrows); a chest appears.
items.notes: A Deku Stick works instead of Fire Arrows (sticks are in the nearby barrels).

items.name: Waterwheel room: bubble under the entry platform
items.howTo: Underneath the platform you enter the room on; sink down as Zora and swim into (or cut) the bubble.

items.name: Waterwheel room: Big Skulltula on the west platform
items.howTo: Ride the rising platform west of the door up to a ledge with rupees and kill the Big Skulltula there.

items.name: Central chamber: barrel on the west side
items.howTo: Use the rotating platform to reach the side platforms on the west side and break the barrel (roll into it).

items.name: Central chamber: jar in the whirlpool
items.howTo: A lone jar sits at the bottom in the eye of the spinning water. From solid ground shoot it with an arrow and pull the fairy in with the Great Fairy's Mask (or sink down as Zora, cut it and swim into the fairy).

items.name: Map room: pot on the small platform
items.howTo: Across from the Dungeon Map chest is a small platform with two pots; break them (Hookshot from afar, or hop over as Deku) and use the Great Fairy's Mask.

items.name: Bio Deku Baba hall: chest
items.area: Bio Deku Baba hallway (green path, B1)
items.howTo: Kill all the Bio Deku Babas (the ones hanging upside down and the last one on the far platform) and open the chest that appears on the ledge.

items.name: Compass room: jar between the Dexihands
items.howTo: By the door, a jar sits between two Dexihands in the flowing water. Shoot it and use the Great Fairy's Mask (or let the Dexihands shake you into it).

items.name: Green-switch room: chest above the grate
items.area: Green switch room (north, behind the waterfall)
items.howTo: Freeze the waterfall in the central chamber to climb to this room. From the yellow platform make ice platforms with Ice Arrows towards the north wall, turn round and Hookshot the ceiling target through the grate; open the chest up there.
items.notes: 3DS: ice only forms on sparkling water spots.

items.name: Gear room: hookshot to the torch alcove
items.howTo: After reversing the flow, take the middle path. Ride the rising platform and turning gear to the back-and-forth platform, turn right and Hookshot the torch (or the chest) in the hidden alcove; open the chest.
items.notes: StrategyWiki words this as two chests both reached from the frozen waterwheel; Zelda Dungeon's walkthrough and guide put this one at the torch alcove.

items.name: Gear room: chest from the frozen waterwheel
items.howTo: Freeze the water on the waterwheel with an Ice Arrow, climb onto the stopped wheel, stand at the tip of a diagonal blade and Hookshot the chest in the north alcove.

items.name: See-saw room: barrel under the first see-saw
items.howTo: At the first see-saw, sink down as Zora on either side and ram/cut the barrel underwater.

items.name: See-saw room: chest in the enclosed area
items.howTo: From the green switch platform, kill the Real Bombchu, walk along the green pipe, climb up at its end as Zora, go right and drop into the enclosed area; Hookshot the chest.

items.name: Pre-boss room: bubble in the exit tunnel
items.howTo: In the tunnel leading back to the central chamber (right side of the room), sink down, pop the bubble with Zora fins and swim through the fairy.

items.name: Pre-boss room: bubble under the green platform
items.howTo: Directly under the central green platform. Stand on the green pipe where it leaves the water, shoot the bubble with an arrow and pull it in with the Great Fairy's Mask.

sections.title: Stone Tower Temple
sections.note: Stray Fairies go back to their spots with the Song of Time, so collect all 15 and take them to the fountain in one cycle. The Great Fairy's Mask draws free fairies to you.

items.name: Entrance: chest from the eye switch
items.howTo: Shoot the golden eye switch in the giant face straight ahead; a chest appears on a platform. Jump to it (Bunny Hood or Zora Mask) and open it.

items.name: Map room: hookshot to the ceiling ledge
items.area: Lower west room (Armos room with the Dungeon Map)
items.howTo: In the room below the floor-switch room, Hookshot the target near the sunlit ceiling to reach a hidden ledge and open the chest.

items.name: Mirror room: chest from a Sun Face
items.howTo: Punch out the pillars by the door as Goron to let the light in. Stand in the light, turn right and reflect it with the Mirror Shield onto the far-left of the Sun Faces; open the chest.

items.name: Mirror room: chest behind the Sun Block
items.howTo: From the light, charge the mirror on the right side of the central pillar, then use its beam on the Sun Block to your right; past the Nejiron is a chest.

items.name: Lava room: chest in the rupee alcove
items.howTo: From the ladder side, fly as Deku out over the lava; after the first updraft veer left to the platform with rupees and open the chest.

items.name: Lava room: chest behind the flames
items.howTo: As Goron, Goron Pound the big switch in the lava near the entrance, then roll round to the switch on the far side before the fire returns; this douses the flames round a chest. Fly there as Deku via the updrafts and open it.
items.notes: Widely considered the hardest Stray Fairy in the game (tight roll timing).

items.name: Bridge room: chest after the Eyegore
items.area: Bridge room (Floating Bridge, upright, on the bridge)
items.howTo: Coming back from the Garo Master, cross the bridge and defeat the first Eyegore (shoot its eye after it attacks); a chest appears by the other door.

items.name: Inverted entrance: chest from the Sun Face
items.howTo: Stand on the Majora emblem in the inverted entrance, turn round and shoot the Sun Face straight above you with a Light Arrow; a chest appears.

items.name: Inverted updraft room: frozen eye switch
items.area: Updraft room (inverted; the upright water room)
items.howTo: Drop down and turn round: under the starting platform is a frozen eye switch. Melt it with a Fire Arrow; a chest appears in an alcove reached from the middle updraft as Deku (or Hookshot).

items.name: Inverted updraft room: chest in the flames
items.area: Updraft room (inverted; the upright water room)
items.howTo: Upright first: sink to the bottom of the water room as Zora, clear the mines and step on the floor switch to create the chest. Inverted: on the east platform, hold its floor switch with an Elegy of Emptiness statue to remove the flames, then fly up to the north platform's chest as Deku.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's walkthrough says the underwater switch's chest gives 'a small key later', but its N64 and 3DS fairy guides and StrategyWiki tie it to this fairy; the small key here comes from the Hiploop-bridge switch.

items.name: Inverted lava room: chest after Wizzrobe
items.howTo: Defeat Wizzrobe; Hookshot to the chest that appears and open it.

items.name: Entrance pit: chest from the Death Armos switch
items.howTo: Inverted: step on the floor switch next to the Death Armos to make a chest appear on the ceiling (you Hookshot it on the way to the boss). Then flip the tower back and, upright, drop into the entrance's lower pit and open the chest.

items.name: Bridge room: chest behind the Sun Block
items.howTo: Let the Dexihand throw you onto the ledge and hit the crystal switch behind the metal lattice (Bomb or Spin Attack) to create a chest. Then reach the other ledge (Zora Mask grab from the water) and remove the Sun Block with a Light Arrow; kill the Beamos and open the chest.

items.name: Water room: chest from the inverted Sun Face
items.area: Water room (upright; the inverted updraft room)
items.howTo: Inverted: from the central bridge shoot the upside-down Sun Face at the edge of the north platform with a Light Arrow. Upright: sink down in the water room and open the chest now on top of the platform.

items.name: Hiploop room: chest from the inverted crystal switch
items.howTo: Inverted: in the room before the boss door, slash the crystal switch. Upright: follow the rooms round past the mirror and lava rooms to the narrow Hiploop room, drop to the bottom and open the chest.

sections.title: Great Fairies
sections.note: Each reward is kept through the Song of Time once earned.

items.name: Great Fairy of Magic (as Deku)
items.howTo: Bring the Clock Town Stray Fairy to the fountain in North Clock Town as Deku Link (first cycle).
items.notes: Required for the story (Deku bubbles). Same in 3DS.

items.name: Great Fairy of Magic (as human)
items.howTo: In a later cycle, bring the Clock Town Stray Fairy back as human Link.
items.notes: The mask's hair shimmers when a Stray Fairy is in the room and draws free (unbubbled) fairies to Link. Same in 3DS.

items.name: Great Fairy of Power (Woodfall)
items.howTo: Return all 15 Woodfall Temple fairies in one cycle to the fountain in the cave in the south wall of Woodfall (reach it with the Deku Flowers).
items.notes: N64 reward. In 3DS the Woodfall fountain gives the doubled Magic Meter and Snowhead gives the spin attack.

items.name: Great Fairy of Wisdom (Snowhead)
items.howTo: Return all 15 Snowhead Temple fairies in one cycle to the Great Fairy Fountain in the Snowhead area.
items.notes: N64 reward. In 3DS this fountain gives the Great Spin Attack instead (rewards swapped with Woodfall).

items.name: Great Fairy of Courage (Zora Cape)
items.howTo: Return all 15 Great Bay Temple fairies in one cycle to the fountain at Zora Cape (Hookshot across the rocks, bomb the boulders).
items.notes: Halves damage taken. Same in 3DS.

items.name: Great Fairy of Kindness (Ikana Canyon)
items.howTo: Return all 15 Stone Tower Temple fairies in one cycle to the Great Fairy Fountain in Ikana Canyon.
items.notes: Two-handed C-button sword (no shield), strongest regular blade. Same in 3DS.
